messages:
jess: Flagging a set of follow-ups after recent postmortem—the recurring missing-span and late-ETL issues keep popping up. Opening a short owner sync. cc @maria @rahul
maria: Thanks. Can we start with the detection query and the recurrence pattern?
jess: Quick metric I used: ```SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) hr, count(*) spans FROM spans_ingested WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY hr ORDER BY hr DESC``` Peaks every ~12h, small troughs align with ETL batch windows.
rahul: Looking at worker logs, two failure modes: partial-batch drops during OOM and occasional out-of-order watermark commits. Snippet: ```[2026-05-01T04:12:07Z] etl: warn: dropping partial batch shard=9 batch=1123```
monitor-bot: Created incident INC-20500 for "recurring-span-ingest-gaps". Playbook: /playbooks/ingest-partial.md
maria: Proposed owners and SLAs: rahul -> ETL retry + memory hardening (48h), infra -> node scheduling + pod sizing (24h), jess -> postmortem update, SLO calc, recurrence watch (72h). Agree?
infra: Can take node scheduling. Plan: add anti-affinity for heavy-shard pods and bump memory requests for etl-worker to 6Gi on canary. Ticket INF-20500 opened.
rahul: I'll add retry-on-partial logic and a safety check that delays watermark advancement when pending batches exist. PR will be behind a feature flag. WIP at https://git.internal/etl/pull/810 (48h ETA).
jess: I'll add a recurrence monitor: page on second recurrence within 14 days and create a dashboard panel comparing spans_in vs processed_traces.
maria: Action items to add to incident tracker INC-20500:
1) rahul: implement retry + watermark guard, add unit + integration tests, attach heap profile (due +48h)
2) infra: anti-affinity + mem bump canary, run staging validation (due +24h)
3) jess: postmortem narrative update, quantify affected customers and SLO delta (due +72h)
4) monitor-bot: create recurrence rule and alert noise suppression (ASAP)
rahul: :white_check_mark: starting PR and profiler capture now
infra: :white_check_mark: canary infra changes scheduled for next maintenance window
monitor-bot: Recurrence monitor created: "ingest-partial-recurrence". Will page on second hit in 14d.
maria: Also propose a short-term mitigation: if mem pressure detected, route heavy shards to spare capacity rather than dropping. infra can coordinate auto-drain. Agree to add as a separate ticket?
infra: Yes, filing INF-20501 for auto-drain + spare pool placement.
jess: Great. I'll track progress in the postmortem tracker and attach this thread. If canary looks good, we roll fixes to all regions. Reconvene in 48h for updates. Closing triage thread for now.
